name: Deadshot Daiquiri
effect: Crit damage to zombies is increased. Aiming down the sights finds crit area automatically.

name: Double Tap
effect: Weapon base rate of fire is increased.

name: Elemental Pop
effect: Gain a chance to get a random Ammo Mod when firing.

name: Melee Macchiato
effect: Instead of punching with the gun butt during a melee attack, send zombies flying with a powerful punch.

name: PHD Flopper
effect: Gain immunity to all self-inflicted damage and status effects. Trigger and explosion when you dive-to-prone, which is buffed the further you fall. Gain immunity to fall damage.

name: Quick Revive
effect: Health regen delay is reduced by 50%. Time taken to revive allies is reduced by 50%.

name: Speed Cola
effect: Reload and armor plating speed is increased by 30%.

name: Vulture Aid
effect: Loot variety increases, enemies can drop more Essence Vials and ammo.

name: Wisp Tea
effect: A Wisp is summoned and deals damage to zombies.
